questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: He _____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Habitual actions in simple present take 'goes' for third person singular.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: They _____ football right now.
questions.explanation: Actions happening now take present continuous tense 'are playing'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb form: She _____ her homework before her father arrived.
questions.explanation: Past perfect tense 'had finished' precedes another past action.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is fond _____ sweets.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'fond' is followed by preposition 'of'.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The cat jumped _____ the table.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He died _____ a fatal disease.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Distribute these mangoes _____ the two brothers.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Distribute these apples _____ all the children.
questions.explanation: 'Among' is used when dividing between more than two persons.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: The sun rises _____ the east.
questions.explanation: Direction and location take preposition 'in the east'.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She has been living here _____ 2010.
questions.explanation: A specific starting point in time takes 'since'.

questions.q: Change into passive voice: 'He writes a letter.'
options: A letter is write by him.
A letter was written by him.
A letter is written by him.
questions.explanation: Simple present active changes to 'is/am/are + past participle' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into passive voice: 'She helped the poor man.'
options: The poor man had helped by her.
The poor man was helped by her.
The poor man is helped by her.
questions.explanation: Simple past active changes to 'was/were + past participle' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into passive voice: 'Open the door.'
questions.explanation: Imperative commands change to 'Let + object + be + past participle'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into passive voice: 'Who broke the glass?'
options: By whom was the glass broken?
questions.explanation: 'Who' changes to 'By whom + auxiliary + subject + past participle'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: He said, 'I am busy today.'
options: He said that he was busy that day.
He said that I am busy today.
He told he was busy today.
questions.explanation: Direct 'I am... today' changes to 'he was... that day' in past reporting.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: She said to me, 'What is your name?'
options: She told me what my name is.
She said what my name was.
She asked me what my name was.
She asked me what is your name.
questions.explanation: Interrogative sentences change to 'asked + Wh-word + subject + verb'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the east.'
options: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher said sun is rise.
The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
questions.explanation: Universal truths remain unchanged in reported speech.
questions.subject: English
